title: vLLM Hybrid KV Cache Manager
description: vLLM Hybrid KV Cache Manager explains how vLLM allocates and prefix-caches KV blocks for hybrid LLMs that mix full attention, sliding-window attention, local attention, Mamba-style state, or KV-sharing layers. It summarizes the grouping rules, memory layout, coordinator stack, prefix-cache intersection logic, and operational flags such as disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager.

subject.title: CPU-GPU Co-Design for Agentic LLM Inference
